question: ‘My Country, My Life’ is an autobiographical text of which of the following Indian politicians?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lal Krishna Advani**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• My Country My Life is an autobiographical book by L. K. Advani, an Indian politician who served as the Deputy Prime Minister of India.
 
• The book was released on 19 March 2008 by Abdul Kalam, the eleventh President of India.
 
• The book has 1,040 pages and narrates autobiographical accounts and events in the life of Advani.
 
• It became the best-seller book in non-fiction. The book alongside mentions the event in Indian politics and India's history from 1900 till date.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9948f3c6ef487c96d323949e3b7733a1108ba915baadda863b5338e8bd16e768.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Atal Bihari Vajpayee

 
 
• Atal Bihari Vajpayee was an Indian politician and statesman who served as the Prime Minister of India.
 
• He is the recipient of Bharat Ratna (2015), Padma Vibhushan (1992) etc.
 
• Vajpayee authored several works of both prose and poetry:
 
 
• Na Dainyam Na Palayanam, Nayi Chunouti : Naya Avasar, Twenty-One Poems, Chuni Hui Kavitayein etc.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Sharadchandra Pawar**
 
 
• **​**Sharadchandra Govindrao Pawar is an **Indian politician.**
 
• He has served as the **Chief Minister of Maharashtra **for four terms
 
• He wrote the famous Book" **My Terms: From the Grassroots to the Corridors of Power".**
 
 
 
• **Narendra Modi**
 
 
• ​Narendra Damodardas Modi is an **Indian politician serving as the current prime minister of India s**ince 26 May 2014.
 
• **Exam Warriors** is a book by Prime Minister of India Narendra Modi, published in 2018.
 
• He also associated with books such as **Social Harmony, Sabka Saath Sabka Vishwas** etc...
